metaDescription: Order custom cotton poly t shirts for your team or event. Soft, durable, and perfect for screen printing. Get a quote today.
introHtml: Cotton poly t shirts combine the softness of cotton with the durability and wrinkle resistance of polyester. This blend holds up well to frequent washing and maintains its shape, making it a popular choice for uniform programs, event staff, and promotional giveaways. The fabric provides a smooth surface for screen printing or embroidery, ensuring your logo looks crisp. Whether you need lightweight tees for a charity run or sturdy shirts for a construction crew, cotton poly offers a balanced performance that pure cotton or polyester alone cannot match.
